name: Quality & Rework
description:
Inspection sends some items back for repair.

Does more inspection capacity help as much as reducing rework?

Starting assumptions
• Two hours of fixed releases into a repeatable inspection loop.
• Each inspection independently sends 12% of items to repair and reinspection.
• Repair time is positive; the model has no physical defect or measurement simulation.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
